ideas.name: Monthly Forward Discount Carry
ideas.claim: Sort currencies into six portfolios by their one-month forward discounts. Go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest, rebalancing monthly.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Foreign currencies against the US dollar; the paper also reports a developed-country sample that includes major currencies.
rules.entry: At each month-end, sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount; go long the highest and short the lowest.
rules.exit: Rebalance at the end of each month.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average excess returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency baskets.
